dct_description_sm: All elicitation materials from session with Nancy Jones on February 11th, 2025. This session begun the investigation into the acceptability of obviative subjects/agents of VTIs, VAIs and VTAs. The attitude verbs were tested by providing a context and test sentences with obviative subjects or agents. The verbs tested were 'forget', 'hope', and 'observe'.
dct_title_s: Elicitation Materials for Anishinaabemowin Field Methods from February 11th, 2025
